keywords.BLINK: Leaves the field and returns (keeps counters and modifications).
keywords.BOND: A Dragon and a Dragon Rider may bond at spell speed, sharing half base stats, non-keyword abilities and types.
keywords.COMMAND: Demand target player (unless specified) X. They may not refuse. Counts as a contract per player.
keywords.CORRUPTED MANA: 1 mana that can only pay for creatures played from your discard pile. A creature in your discard pile can be played by paying its whole cost with Corrupted Mana.
keywords.CRITICAL: When inflicting damage to another player, they don't draw a card.
keywords.CRITICAL BOOST: When this creature boosts another creature's attack, that attack gains CRITICAL.
keywords.DEMIGOD: At the beginning of your Upkeep, reduce the Demigod count by 1. At 0, this creature ascends and becomes a God.
keywords.DEVOUR: Destroy target creature; gain half its attack/defense and inherit all its keywords.
keywords.DMG GAIN: If this creature survives a CLASH it gains +1/+1.
keywords.DOUBLE STRIKE: When inflicting damage to another player, they lose 2 life instead of 1.
keywords.FACEOFF: You can select an opposing player's creature as an attack target.
keywords.FADE OUT: Leaves the game until the End Phase, then returns untapped to its controller's field. Counters stay.
keywords.FLASH: May be played at Incantation speed.
keywords.GIFT: Gift target player (unless specified) X. Counts as a contract per player.
keywords.GUIDE: Look at the top X cards. Put them back in any order or on the bottom in any order.
keywords.HASTE: Can attack and use TAP abilities the turn it is played.
keywords.INDESTRUCTIBLE: This creature cannot receive damage or be destroyed. SACRIFICE gets around it.
keywords.INFECT: At the end of its controller's next turn, the infected creature becomes a 1/1 Zombie with no abilities under your control. If it is destroyed before then, you create a 1/1 Zombie Token.
keywords.OFFER: Each opponent (unless specified) may accept or refuse X. Each acceptance is a contract (+1 Soul for you).
keywords.PHASE OUT: Leaves the field until end of turn (keeps counters and modifications).
keywords.RECONFIGURE: Once per round (from the start of your turn to your next), you may untap this whenever you have priority.
keywords.SACRIFICE: Destroy a creature you control as a cost; gets around INDESTRUCTIBLE.
keywords.SHAPESHIFTER: This creature counts as every creature type.
keywords.TRAMPLE: As in MTG: excess attack over the blocker's defense is dealt to the defending player.
keywords.VIGILANCE: This creature does not tap when attacking.
